text:
Marta: Preprod -> prod promotion blocked by deploy-bot, grabbing attention. deploy-bot says values signature differs and it refused to promote. anyone on?

deploy-bot: PROMOTE CHECK FAILED
preprod values hash: abc123de
prod values hash: def456ab
reason: key mismatch at path `feature_flags.new_ui`

Alex: Ugh. Which change introduced that in preprod?

Sam: That was me — I flipped new_ui=true in preprod to validate the rollout a few hours ago, forgot to mirror to prod. quick smoke only.

Sasha: Ok. Two choices: patch prod with the new flag (small hotpatch), or revert preprod so promotion can continue. Which do we want?

Jay: Given this is a feature-flag flip for a non-blocking UI test, I'd prefer patching prod during a short release window so staging alignment holds. Patch = update prod values and ship a micro release (chart bump + release note).

Marta: Agree with Jay if risk low. Sam, can you create the prod values patch and a brief release note blurb?

Sam: Will do. Drafting now. Plan: create chart version 1.3.2-hotfix, update values-prod.yaml with `feature_flags.new_ui: true`, run promotion through deploy-bot.

Alex: Note: add health-check and rollout strategy to limit blast radius — maxUnavailable=1 and 30s readiness probe.

Oncall: Watchlist: error-rate, 5xx count, latency p50/p95. Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1% OR 5xx spike > 2x baseline for 5m. Notify #oncall if triggered.

deploy-bot: Suggested helm commands:
```
# dry-run in prod namespace
helm upgrade --install mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace prod --values values-prod.yaml --set feature_flags.new_ui=true --version 1.3.2-hotfix --dry-run
# if OK, apply
helm upgrade --install mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace prod --values values-prod.yaml --set feature_flags.new_ui=true --version 1.3.2-hotfix
```

Sasha: Also create a short canary: 10% traffic to the new revision for 10m before full cutover. Deploy-bot supports traffic-split via rollout annotation.

Sam: Draft release note: "Release 1.3.2-hotfix: enable new_ui feature flag in prod for extended UI smoke tests. Canary 10% for 10m. Rollback criteria defined; oncall watching." Will post PR to release-notes repo and attach to the promotion.

Marta: Timing? I'm proposing 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Sam, can you schedule deploy and I will be on standby for approvals and rollback if needed. 

Sam: 02:00 UTC works. I'll push chart + values PR in ~15m and kick the deploy at 02:00.

Alex: Add `--timeout 10m` to helm to ensure we don't hang. Also ensure deploy-bot gets the release-notes link in the promotion comment.

Jay: I'll stub the release-notes entry now and mark it as draft. Sam attach the PR URL once ready.

Oncall: I'll set up a short alert runbook in PagerDuty for the window and enable extra logging for the service.

Marta: Sounds good. Action items: Sam (create chart bump + values patch + release note PR), Jay (accept release-notes draft + assist), Alex (confirm helm readiness probe/timeouts), Oncall (monitor + alert). We'll mark this thread resolved after promotion completes or if a rollback happens. :thumbsup:

Sam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/431 (draft). Chart PR: https://github.com/redwood/mysvc-chart/pull/289. Will add deploy-bot comment when ready to run. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promotion preflight re-run queued once PRs are merged and `promote` tag applied.

Marta: Thanks — we'll reconvene in the channel 01:50 UTC for final signoff.

Alex: :thumbsup:

Jay: :white_check_mark:

Oncall: :ok_hand:
